messages:
Sam: heads-up — noticed the app-of-apps sync in eu-west stalled during today's rollout. several child apps are stuck in 'PruneInProgress' and GPU nodepools didn't autoscale.
Jordan: saw this too. ArgoCD leader rotated at the same time. logs show repeated leader-election timeouts + prune concurrency errors.
Priya: any recent config changes to argocd-cm or appset?
Sam: no config PRs, but we did push a terraform bump to gpu-pool autoscaler yesterday (reduced min nodes). could be related.
Miguel: pasting the argocd controller log excerpt:
```
E0318 10:42:12.123 1 leader_election.go:220] failed to update lease: Operation cannot be fulfilled, rolling back
W0318 10:42:12.125 1 sync.go:478] prune queue threshold exceeded, delaying prune wave
E0318 10:42:13.298 1 leader_election.go:187] failed to acquire leader lease: resource name not found
```
Jordan: confirms: leader lost lock repeatedly for ~90s, which overlaps prune waves. when ArgoCD loses leader during prune it leaves some apps half-cleaned -> appset fanout stalls.
Sam: consequence = GPU pools remain at old size because the autoscaler job is triggered by the app that never finishes, so capacity requests never reconcile. cost risk: reserved GPUs remain idle for hours.
Priya: quick mitigation? force a single controller leader or pause prune?
Miguel: immediate playbook I suggest: 1) scale down appset concurrency by editing appset controller config to reduce parallelism; 2) bump leader-election TTL to 30s temporarily; 3) manually trigger a controller restart on one replica to force stable leader.
Jordan: command to bump TTL (cluster-admin):
```
kubectl -n argocd patch configmap argocd-cm --patch '{"data":{"controller.leader-election-lease-duration":"30s"}}'
kubectl -n argocd rollout restart deployment/argocd-application-controller
```
Sam: I'm doing 1 and 2 now. will monitor.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-78 - argocd leader rotation causing appset prune hang (severity: medium)
Priya: also opened a temporary alert to watch orphaned GPU nodepools and idle reserved hours.
Miguel: long term fixes we should PR: - reduce prune wave batch size, - add idempotent cleanup for partial prunes, - restore autoscaler min nodes to previous value or tie autoscaler to k8s nodepool provider metrics instead of app completion.
Jordan: noted. I'll open a PR to argocd-cm and an RFC for appset prune backoff logic.
Sam: thanks all, if this stabilizes in 10m I'll close the incident. :thumbsup:
Miguel: follow-up action items: /assign @Jordan to the config PR, @Priya to the alert, @Sam to run postmortem if incident stays >1h.
Jordan: got it, working on PR now.
Sam: update — leader stable after restart, a bunch of prunes resumed, GPU autoscaler triggered two new nodes. still watching for any stray finalizers.
Jordan: good sign. will run a quick sweep for remaining orphaned resources tomorrow.
